question: Two candidates are contesting in an election. All votes are valid votes. A candidate who gets 38% of votes is rejected by 28,800 votes. The total number of votes polled is:
solution:
Given:

A candidate who gets 38% of the votes is rejected by 28,800 votes.

Calculation:

Let the total votes polled be x.

The number of votes the winner gets = 62% of x

⇒ 62xover100 

Number of votes received by the lost candidates = 38% of x

⇒ 38xover100 

Difference,

62xover100 - 38xover100 = 2,88,00

⇒ 24xover100 = 2,88,00

⇒ x = {2,88,00 times 100}over24 = 1,20,000

**∴ The total number of votes polled is 1,20,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Rejected candidates gets vote 38%

Selected candidate gets vote (100 - 38)% = 62%

Difference between both candidates vote = 62% - 38% = 24%

Value of 24 % = 28,800

⇒ 1% = 28,800 / 24 =1200

⇒ 100% = 1200 × 100 = 1,20,000 (Total vote)

**∴ Option 4 is correct.**
